livia01.bark.vestal_a: The flame is too high for this hour. You saw it too, didn't you?
livia01.bark.vestal_b: The augur comes today. Fix your veil, Lívia.
livia03.bark.augur: A fine afternoon for a vigil, priestess.
livia03.bark.augur_close: Watching the gate? So do I.
theron01.bark.bibulo: Three coins and the whole day ahead. Anyone want a game?
theron01.bark.mercadora: That tooth man... Have I seen that face? No. I don't think so.
theron01.bark.escriba: Fraud number four today. And it isn't even noon.
theron02.bark.escriba: A man in a torn tunic. Anyone seen him? Nobody ever does.
theron04.bark.nerea: Hurry up. The lamp is running out, and your tunic won't mend itself.
theron04.bark.nerea_danger: Don't look at the street. Come and sit. Pretend it's any other day.
asterion04.bark.mirto: Faster! I can hear them on the stairs!
asterion04.bark.livia: They follow my fire. Don't stop.
theron02.bark.honest: The honest tooth man! I told the joke at home. Nobody laughed. I did.
theron02.d_nw_name: I heard you at the market yesterday: "it was mine, I pulled it out". People laughed. I believe you.
theron02.bark.hero: And the man selling the Minotaur's tooth? Nobody remembers the hero's name. Or his.
theron03.d_pose_echo.provocou: You provoke well. Let's see if you work as well as you talk.
theron03.d_pose_echo.calou: You have barely said a word. I like that in a man who will carry secrets.
theron03.d_pose_echo.urna: You haven't taken your eyes off the urn. It hasn't taken its eyes off you either.
livia04.d06b: Without meaning to, Lívia hears herself murmuring the prayer no one taught her, the same as on the morning the flame bowed. The flame in the cup leans toward her, as it did that morning.
